project.name: GIS-Point Operations
project.description: Operational board for GIS-Point: weekly, monthly, quarterly, semiannual and annual plans and tasks, run as a kanban.

states.name: Backlog
states.description: Captured, not committed yet. Everything starts here.

states.name: Todo
states.description: Committed for the current horizon, ready to be pulled.

states.name: In Progress
states.description: Actively being worked on. Respect the WIP limit.

states.name: In Review
states.description: Work is done, waiting on review, approval or hand-off.

states.name: Cancelled
states.description: Dropped on purpose. Keep it for the record, do not delete.

seed_issues.name: Weekly ops review: board hygiene and blockers
seed_issues.description: Every Monday: walk the board right to left, clear anything stuck In Review, re-pull from Todo, and make sure each active card has an assignee.

seed_issues.name: Monthly operations report
seed_issues.description: Close the month: delivery numbers, utilisation, what slipped and why, what changes next month.

seed_issues.name: Q+1 operations plan
seed_issues.description: Set the quarterly priorities for operations and break them down into monthly work items.

seed_issues.name: Half-year operations audit
seed_issues.description: Review processes, tooling and supplier contracts. Decide what to keep, fix or retire for the second half of the year.

seed_issues.name: Annual operations roadmap
seed_issues.description: Company-level operational goals for the year, split into quarterly themes that feed this board.
